newsitem.title: UK: Jan Syrian Light offered at Dated +13 cts - trade.
newsitem.headline: Jan Syrian Light offered at Dated +13 cts - trade.

text.p: Syria's monthly crude price negotiations started awkwardly on Thursday with Sytrol's first offer being rejected outright by contract holders, term buyers said.
One contract holder said Sytrol's first offer of Dated Brent +13 cents for January Syrian Light "had us laughing all day".
He said +13 represented an eight cent rise against December, while the price of Urals, its main competitor, has fallen by about 50 cents per barrel in the same time.
"We just sent them a telex back without any numbers, asking them to revise their ideas. We are still waiting," he added.
He said that Sytrol should reduce its Syrian Light price to Dated Brent -60 cents, but conceded that -40 was a more likely number.
